name: Prompt Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request: {}
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Enable corepack
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm run lint

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm run test

      - name: Build project
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Set Sentry environment to production
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: echo "SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=production" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Set Sentry environment to staging
        if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'
        run: echo "SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=staging" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Upload source maps to Sentry
        uses: getsentry/action-release@v1
        with:
          environment: ${{ env.SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT }}
          inject: true
          sourcemaps: true
          dist: dist
          finalize: true
          ignore_missing: true
          ignore_empty: true
          version: ${{ github.sha }}
          projects: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          url_prefix: /dist
          working_directory: .
        env:
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          SENTRY_RELEASE: ${{ github.sha }}
          SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ env.SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Run Sentry error test
        run: node dist/sentry-error-test.js || true
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
